notes.title: Major Update coming but Thanks in advanced!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11089999/0df0e60642ab55b53911b93934fe7b026f7c7ecc.png
Hello Miolhrians! 
I would like to start off by thanking our private funder who has help our world expand beyond belief. Our Next update is coming together and would like to thank everyone for their support.
We also found an amazing steamer who will help many of you explore Miolhria!
The newest update set to release Jan 20 will include much more features and update including resolution and much more with graphics for tons of things including titles and more!!
It has been a long Yearlong slumber, but we are near the goal.
We are currently working on making it more stable, and this work sometimes involves turning some features.
We know that this can be a major inconvenience, and we apologize - but it is all done in order to have a safe and stable version. So, whenever you feel that we are not as communicative as you think we should be, please have patience with us!

Last I would like to thank all who supported us way back with our game first hit greenlight and those who play with everything we have had to update and patch over time!
We appreciate your patience more than you can imagine! 
Lots of love, 
Miolhr Company Team

notes.title: Thanks Everyone!
notes.content:
Hello Miolhrians!!

I just wanted to post a quick message thanking everyone for the Support! Also wanted to apologies for the game taking as long as it has with multiple issues I suppose it comes with getting into the field of game development solo but well worth it! Great News as the game looks to be coming close to Beta soon! I took the time to list all current items features and more for Build 16.7! I will also work on a Video to help with New Survivors! Above all else Have a Great Night and Survive!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11089999/38431d1bf00223dd324531fe1adf575ebc6cdf9a.png
Miolhr is an Open World Zombie Survival Capture Sim Game. It consist of you having to maintain your characters Food, Water, and Rest while exploring Miolhria. The game is more in depth then most survival games though a ton of features.

Survival: Not only do you have to worry about Your standard meters but Temp and Watts(Electricity) in a big thing in Miolhria. You temp depends on the clothing you wear, Weather(Snow, Rain, Heatwave etc.) or Food, Drink you have taken. 
Watts determine if you can use crafting or any electrical device. Keep in mine each time you use a device it uses Watts in game.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11089999/7210e7ebaad2eb4e3141e9560d821fefd8250f91.png
Capture System: Kind of like in pokemon you can capture animal creatures but just those that are underground or in caves. You will be a be able to use them for one of 3 ways. You can tame them and use them to defend your home, Ride them or for there Perks. Capture Devices can be purchased from traders or crafted.

Elements of Miolhria: Miohria is full of Illnesses. Fighting enemies and losing can result in you getting poisoned, burned, cutting yourself(bleeding) or a ton of other illnesses. Keep supplies on you to stay ahead of this!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11089999/01b52d705c98b4d1e3bae666a0cecf26398327e6.png
Traders and Quest: You can find traders in Miolhria to trade your good and buys items to survive. Quest can be taken from Computers or NPC's in game. They range from recover items, Delivery or even defeat an enemy for them.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11089999/de5821eb6ed95366bab21a2b3954936a35308b0b.png
Homes: You can purchase Homes in Miolhria by buying deeds from traders or getting them from quest! You home can be decorated with Devices, Furniture, Security Devices and even Captured pet to help you out. Having a home can also lead to attacks so good luck with defending it as you could lose it!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11089999/af48ea5ce09f5c50a2aff0801d3d1ff94552c3cc.png
Battles: Miolhrian battles are a step into Simulation. This is due to Day/Night/Type of Enemy/Location of Battle factor into you win percentage. Keep in mind each lose can deplete you life(HP) hit you with Illness or even slow you down enough where other enemies can surround you! Defeating an enemy will give you loot but will also slow you down if you don't have inventory space to carry it allowing enemies to take advantage! Attacking will give you more loot but has a higher chance of getting more damage on loss and higher chance of illness. Defending allows you to jump back before battle helping you escape if you win or lose.(allowing enemies not to surround you! Speed may be a good strategy!) You also get less loot with defending but can increase chance at winning!

POI: There are tons of POI for Deli, Auto Shops, Homes and even malls in Miolhria to loot! The best way to loot these locations is by having a Bike or Kart which allows you to store more.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11089999/bea7fc0e038457f95121af7f77245d435db65eea.png
(8)Bikes & (1)Karts: Bikes are a good way of getting around town! Not only this but some also include features from storage, lanterns, heating and cooling. Karts are a good way to having extra storage but take up a lot of room.

Enemies: Enemies Range From Bandits, Animals and Zombies!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11089999/fefb483d9333cd074175007d809d238602fc2fca.png
Bandits Looters Raiders: Looters will only attack you when you sleep stealing your money. You can counter this with some devices in game or having good security on you Base.
Raiders and Bandits are found throughout Miolhria and are mostly found in POI's. This will not stop them from surprise attacks or Raids oh Safehouses and Bases. Bandits are know to take you money when winning in battle and are know to set up mini bases in Towns. By looting them you can make a lot of money!
Raiders tend to have more capture related items but aren't as strong as bandits!
Zombies range from Poison, Water, Fire, and Ice. These Zombies will hit you with illnesses upon getting a win and something even an Infection which prevents you from healing! Keep an eye out as Boss Zombies can be found thought Miohria and do a lot of damage but have the best loot!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11089999/de5821eb6ed95366bab21a2b3954936a35308b0b.png
There are multiple Devices from Workbenches, Sewing machines, Dark Matter Teleporters, Storage containers, Research Benches and tons more to Loot, Craft, Upgrade in Miolhria!

CAS: Every time you sleep you have a Chance of Calling on Multiple Events or (Chance at Survival)!
Chance at Survival are random events that happen at Random!
They are but not limited to:
Air Drops, Bandit Spawning Bases, NPC leaving Biome, Trader coming to Safehouses, Hordes Breaking in, Bandit Breaking in, Weather Change, Heatwave, Coldwave, Waterpipes breaking Boss Zombies in the Area and Horde base attack! (Tornado's have been removed for tweaking)
